title: The Dice of Houses
text: A giant's dice, each as tall as a man, lie in a ring of standing stones. Every face bears a House's emblem, carved deep, and yours are among them. The grass around them is flattened as if they have been rolling. They want to be thrown.

options.label: Throw the giant's dice, and let fate choose which House it favours.

outcomes.text: They roll a long way and stop. They name a House, and gold rains on it out of a clear sky.
They roll a long way and stop. They name a House, and its Scions feel the stones lean on them, heavy and cold.

options.label: The wisest weighs them before anyone throws, suspecting a trick.

outcomes.text: Loaded, every one, and they can read whose hand loaded them.

options.label: Leave them lying in their ring. Some games are not meant for you.

outcomes.text: The stones hum, disappointed, and as you leave one die rolls over on its own. Every hand in the party itches to throw it for a day after.
